supporting_pages.title: "Control MCP use with Identity and Access Management \_|\_ Google Cloud MCP\
evidence_snippets: Deny MCP use by service The following IAM deny policy prevents use of MCP tools from a specific service for all users. { "rules" : [ { "denyRule" : { "deniedPrincipals" : [ "principalSet://goog/public:all" ], "deniedPermissions" : [ "mcp.googleapis.com/tools.call" ], "denialCondition" : { "title" : "Deny all MCP tool use from this service" , "expression" : "resource.service == ' SERVICE NAME '" } } } ] } Replace SERVICE NAME with the service name—for example, bigquery.googleapis.com .

Deny policy attributes The following attributes can be used in your Identity and Access Management deny policies: tool.isReadOnly : a resource attribute that indicates whether the invoked tool only reads data. request.auth.oauth.client id : the OAuth client ID. resource.service : the name of service—for example, bigquery.googleapis.com .
